# Columbia University

> Columbia University is a leading research university offering academic programs, research resources, libraries, news, and services across its schools and institutes.

Columbia University’s web presence spans central university information, admissions, academics, research, libraries, schools, institutes, and major public-facing resources. This file highlights authoritative pages that help language models navigate the university’s core content and high-value subdomains.

## University Overview
- [Columbia University Home](https://www.columbia.edu/): Main university homepage with access to academics, research, campus life, and institutional resources.
- [About Columbia](https://www.columbia.edu/content/about-columbia): Overview of the university’s history, mission, leadership, and campuses.
- [Academics](https://www.columbia.edu/content/academics): Central entry point for schools, programs, and academic opportunities.
- [Research](https://www.columbia.edu/content/research): Overview of Columbia’s research enterprise, institutes, and innovation activity.
- [Campus Life](https://www.columbia.edu/content/campus-life): Information about student life, housing, arts, wellness, and campus services.
- [Administration](https://www.columbia.edu/content/administration): Access to leadership, governance, and administrative offices.
- [Schools and Colleges](https://www.columbia.edu/content/schools-and-colleges): Directory of Columbia’s undergraduate, graduate, and professional schools.

## Admissions and Academics
- [Undergraduate Admissions](https://undergrad.admissions.columbia.edu/): Admissions information for Columbia College and Columbia Engineering first-year and transfer applicants.
- [Graduate Admissions](https://gsas.columbia.edu/admissions): Admissions guidance for Graduate School of Arts and Sciences programs.
- [School of General Studies Admissions](https://www.gs.columbia.edu/content/admissions): Admissions for nontraditional undergraduate students at Columbia.
- [Columbia College](https://www.college.columbia.edu/): Undergraduate liberal arts college with curriculum, advising, and student resources.
- [Columbia Engineering](https://www.engineering.columbia.edu/): Engineering school homepage with academic departments, research, and student information.
- [Bulletin](https://bulletin.columbia.edu/): Official academic bulletin with degree requirements, courses, and school policies.
- [Directory of Courses](https://directoryofclasses.columbia.edu/): Searchable course listings by term, subject, and school.

## Libraries and Scholarly Resources
- [Columbia University Libraries](https://library.columbia.edu/): Main library system with catalogs, services, research help, and digital collections.
- [CLIO](https://clio.columbia.edu/): Library catalog for books, journals, databases, and other holdings.
- [Digital Collections](https://dlc.library.columbia.edu/): Digitized archives, manuscripts, images, and special collections from Columbia Libraries.
- [Archives and Special Collections](https://library.columbia.edu/libraries/rarebookmanuscript.html): Rare books, manuscripts, and archival research resources.
- [Research Guides](https://guides.library.columbia.edu/): Subject and course guides curated by Columbia librarians.
- [Academic Commons](https://academiccommons.columbia.edu/): Institutional repository for Columbia scholarship, research outputs, and open access materials.

## Research Institutes and Data Resources
- [Columbia Climate School](https://climate.columbia.edu/): University-wide climate research, education, and policy initiatives.
- [Lamont-Doherty Earth Observatory](https://lamont.columbia.edu/): Earth and climate science research institute with labs, expeditions, and publications.
- [International Research Institute for Climate and Society](https://iri.columbia.edu/): Climate and society research institute focused on risk, resilience, and decision support.
- [IRI Data Library](https://iridl.ldeo.columbia.edu/): Open-access climate and environmental data repository with analysis and visualization tools.
- [Data Library Map Rooms](https://iridl.ldeo.columbia.edu/maproom/): Interactive climate map tools for monitoring, forecasting, and regional analysis.
- [Earth Institute Archive](https://www.earth.columbia.edu/): Archived Earth Institute site documenting interdisciplinary sustainability and environmental work.
- [Zuckerman Institute](https://zuckermaninstitute.columbia.edu/): Neuroscience and brain science institute with research, education, and public programs.

## Schools and Professional Education
- [Graduate School of Arts and Sciences](https://gsas.columbia.edu/): Graduate programs, admissions, funding, and academic policies for arts and sciences.
- [Columbia Business School](https://business.columbia.edu/): Business education, faculty research, executive education, and degree programs.
- [Columbia Law School](https://www.law.columbia.edu/): Law school academics, clinics, centers, and admissions information.
- [Vagelos College of Physicians and Surgeons](https://www.vagelos.columbia.edu/): Medical education, biomedical research, and clinical training programs.
- [Mailman School of Public Health](https://www.publichealth.columbia.edu/): Public health education, research, and policy initiatives.
- [School of International and Public Affairs](https://www.sipa.columbia.edu/): Public policy and international affairs graduate education and research.
- [Teachers College](https://www.tc.columbia.edu/): Graduate school of education, health, and psychology affiliated with Columbia.
- [School of Professional Studies](https://sps.columbia.edu/): Professional master’s degrees, certificates, and lifelong learning programs.

## Student Services and Campus Resources
- [University Life](https://universitylife.columbia.edu/): Student support, inclusion, engagement, and campus experience resources.
- [Housing](https://www.housing.columbia.edu/): Residential services, housing options, and application information.
- [Dining](https://dining.columbia.edu/): Campus dining locations, meal plans, and food service updates.
- [Health Services](https://www.health.columbia.edu/): Medical, counseling, and wellness services for students.
- [Registrar](https://www.registrar.columbia.edu/): Registration, academic calendar, transcripts, and enrollment services.
- [Financial Aid and Educational Financing](https://cc-seas.financialaid.columbia.edu/): Financial aid information for Columbia College and Engineering students.
- [Student Financial Services](https://sfs.columbia.edu/): Billing, payments, refunds, and student account support.

## News, Events, and Public Communication
- [Columbia News](https://news.columbia.edu/): Official university news, research stories, and institutional announcements.
- [Events at Columbia](https://events.columbia.edu/): Central calendar for lectures, conferences, performances, and campus events.
- [Columbia Magazine](https://magazine.columbia.edu/): Alumni magazine featuring university news, profiles, and long-form stories.
- [Office of Public Affairs](https://publicaffairs.columbia.edu/): Media relations, communications, and public information resources.
- [Columbia University Irving Medical Center News](https://www.cuimc.columbia.edu/news): News from Columbia’s medical center and health sciences community.

## Administrative and Public Resources
- [Directory](https://directory.columbia.edu/): University directory for people, offices, and contact information.
- [Human Resources](https://humanresources.columbia.edu/): Employment, benefits, policies, and workplace resources.
- [Careers at Columbia](https://careers.columbia.edu/): Faculty, staff, and academic job opportunities across the university.
- [University Policies](https://universitypolicies.columbia.edu/): Central repository of official university-wide policies.
- [Facilities and Operations](https://facilities.columbia.edu/): Campus operations, maintenance, construction, and building services.
- [Public Safety](https://publicsafety.columbia.edu/): Safety services, emergency information, and crime prevention resources.
- [CUIT](https://www.cuit.columbia.edu/): Columbia University Information Technology services, support, and system status.

## Medical Center and Health Sciences
- [Columbia University Irving Medical Center](https://www.cuimc.columbia.edu/): Academic medical center integrating research, education, and patient care.
- [Vagelos College of Physicians and Surgeons](https://www.vagelos.columbia.edu/): Medical school programs, departments, and research initiatives.
- [College of Dental Medicine](https://www.dental.columbia.edu/): Dental education, patient care, and oral health research.
- [School of Nursing](https://www.nursing.columbia.edu/): Nursing education, clinical practice, and health research programs.
- [Department of Psychiatry](https://www.columbiapsychiatry.org/): Psychiatry research, clinical services, and educational programs.
- [ColumbiaDoctors](https://www.columbiadoctors.org/): Faculty practice site for finding doctors, specialties, and care locations.

## Alumni and Giving
- [Columbia Alumni Association](https://alumni.columbia.edu/): Alumni programs, events, benefits, and community engagement opportunities.
- [Columbia Giving](https://giving.columbia.edu/): University fundraising and philanthropic support information.
- [Columbia College Alumni Association](https://www.cc-seas.columbia.edu/caa): Alumni association for Columbia College and Engineering graduates.
- [Columbia Magazine](https://magazine.columbia.edu/): Alumni-focused stories, features, and university updates.
